en: \[VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了当 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 仅在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中设置时，语音输入在 TLS 检查代理后失败的问题；现在它也会遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
